svg.title: Two readings of the same formula
svg.desc: Left: the binomial probabilities of every possible seed count when the rate is fixed at 0.65. Right: the same formula read as a function of the rate with the count fixed at 26.
svg.text: The same expression, two completely different jobs
These forty-one bars add to exactly 1.
The shaded area is 1 over 41, about 0.024.
Both panels evaluate the same expression, and both pass through 0.1313. Only the left one is a probability distribution.
The right-hand curve is a likelihood: its height ranks rates against each other and is not a probability for pi.
